title: Archetype Library Extraction
extraction_rules: An archetype represents reusable environmental medium/topology/structural behavior, not a named setting or complete encounter profile.

Climate, transient weather, contamination, magical influence, abandonment/decay, post-apocalyptic state, overgrowth, and other condition/state dimensions are not promoted to archetype identity merely because they appear in an existing environment name.
A preset may use one primary archetype and zero or more secondary archetypes when multiple baseline behaviors materially coexist.
Existing source profile names remain preset/source identities; archetype extraction never renames or replaces source evidence.
Player/creature/species abilities, equipment, vehicles, world distribution, and participant adaptations remain externally owned and are evaluated against resolved environments.

archetypes.name: Wetland
archetypes.baseline_scope: Waterlogged or saturated terrestrial terrain where shallow water, mud/soft ground, vegetation, and limited firm footing shape movement, navigation, shelter, and hazards.

archetypes.name: Open Water Surface
archetypes.baseline_scope: Surface-water travel or activity where there is no reliable traversable ground and movement depends on swimming, vessels, flotation, currents, waves, and weather exposure.

archetypes.name: Submerged
archetypes.baseline_scope: Fully underwater environments where three-dimensional movement, breathing access, pressure, visibility, buoyancy, and waterborne navigation dominate.

archetypes.name: Coastal Interface
archetypes.baseline_scope: Land-water boundary environments where shore access, tides or changing waterline, reefs/shoals, landing points, and mixed terrestrial/aquatic movement interact.
excluded_or_deferred: beach vs cliff vs mangrove substrate

archetypes.name: Forest
archetypes.baseline_scope: Tree-dominated terrestrial terrain where vegetation density, canopy, concealment, limited sightlines, route-finding, and biological resources shape play.

archetypes.name: Open Country
archetypes.baseline_scope: Broad terrestrial terrain with comparatively open sightlines and sparse built or forest cover, where exposure, distance, substrate, and scarce shelter dominate traversal.

archetypes.name: Highland
archetypes.baseline_scope: Steep, elevated, or strongly vertical terrestrial terrain where slopes, cliffs, elevation change, thin-air potential, and rock/ground instability shape navigation.

archetypes.name: Subterranean
archetypes.baseline_scope: Below-ground enclosed terrain—natural or constructed—where constrained passages, darkness, orientation, ventilation, and structural access dominate.
excluded_or_deferred: natural cave vs sewer vs bunker construction

archetypes.name: Built Complex
archetypes.baseline_scope: Discrete constructed sites organized around rooms, corridors, thresholds, chambers, access points, and purposeful spatial design without assuming dense city fabric or active life-support.

archetypes.name: Urban
archetypes.baseline_scope: Dense permanent city fabric where streets, buildings, verticality, crowds, services, districts, surveillance/social pressure, and many route choices interact.

archetypes.name: Settlement
archetypes.baseline_scope: Lower-density or temporary inhabited places where community layout, local shelter/resources, social access, and nearby surrounding terrain matter more than dense metropolitan fabric.

archetypes.name: Industrial & Infrastructure
archetypes.baseline_scope: Engineered production, utility, logistics, or transport spaces where machinery, service networks, access control, hazardous operations, and linear/systemic routes shape play.

archetypes.name: Constructed Habitat
archetypes.baseline_scope: Enclosed engineered environments whose habitability depends materially on controlled systems such as atmosphere, power, access, pressure, temperature, or other life-support infrastructure.

archetypes.name: Space / Void
archetypes.baseline_scope: Open extraterrestrial space where vacuum, radiation exposure, microgravity/zero-gravity potential, enormous distances, tethering/propulsion, and sparse fixed shelter define the baseline.
reusable_behavior: dependence on protective systems or vehicles

archetypes.name: Atmospheric / Aerial
archetypes.baseline_scope: Environments where traversal occurs primarily within an atmosphere above a stable ground surface, with wind, altitude, pressure, weather, and aerial support defining movement and survival.

deferred_gap_watchlist.why: ENV-06 River/Stream may prove materially different from Open Water Surface, Wetland, and Coastal Interface; do not pre-create until expansion evidence is authored.
ENV-09 may show that ice is better handled as substrate/condition plus Highland/Open Country, or justify a distinct archetype.
ENV-07 may remain Submerged/Coastal presets or justify a distinct dense-aquatic-structure archetype after authored expansion.
ENV-10 may remain Industrial & Infrastructure plus surrounding terrain or justify a lighter transport-corridor archetype.
